summary: The task analysis packet for P1.A2 is well-defined, adhering to ADR-043 and ADR-038. The scope is strictly bounded to transient synthetic seed storage with clear isolation from the main P2P service. The design correctly addresses the critical "close-before-delete" requirement and implements necessary safety boundaries for the janitor to prevent accidental deletion of user data. The testing requirements cover all critical failure modes (traversal, write failure, and residue cleanup).
